steps.name: sign_in
steps.comment: A signed-in session with an expired access token and a refresh token good until 2100. Every refresh goes to the harness's blackhole backend and fails to connect, which is a transient failure.
ScreenType.AUTH, as the boot flow opens it after consent: it must refresh before letting the player in

steps.message: the auth screen is resuming the session

steps.comment: nakama-godot retries the refresh until it times out (about 9 s here), then the auth screen continues with the stored session

steps.message: the session survived the failed refresh
a toast says the server is unreachable
